user.title: Solis SDM630 Sniffer
user.description: Choose what to monitor. The meter is read passively from RS485 traffic published to MQTT (requires the MQTT integration). The inverter is read through the Solis S2-WL-ST logger over read-only Modbus TCP; nothing is written, and SolisCloud reporting is not changed.

meter.title: Meter (MQTT)
meter.description: Listen to raw binary traffic containing both Modbus requests and responses. No requests will be sent. Publish the latest sensor readings at the update interval (default 30 seconds). This also controls dashboard, automation, and history updates; availability changes are immediate.

logger.title: Inverter logger (Modbus TCP)
logger.description: Enter the IP address or hostname of the Solis S2-WL-ST logger. It is only read (Modbus function 04). You can change these settings later under Configure.

error.invalid_topic: Enter one exact MQTT topic without wildcards.
error.invalid_timeout: Enter a timeout between 1 and 86400 seconds.
error.invalid_update_interval: Enter an update interval between 1 and 86400 seconds.
error.invalid_logger: Enter a hostname or IP address without scheme or port, a port 1–65535, a unit ID 1–247, and a polling interval of 10–3600 seconds.
error.logger_required: Enter the logger's IP address or hostname.
error.logger_already_configured: This logger host, port and unit ID are already used by another integration entry.
error.cannot_connect: Could not read the logger. Check that it is powered, on your network, and that the IP address, port 502 and unit ID are correct.
error.unsupported_model: The logger answered, but the inverter is not a supported model (S6-EH3P 5–10K-H, model code 0x3306).

abort.mqtt_required: Configure and enable the built-in MQTT integration first.
abort.already_configured: This MQTT topic or logger is already configured.

meter.title: Meter
meter.description: Choose which sign of Total active power means grid import. This affects the grid import/export power sensors only; meter energy counters keep their original direction. Publish the latest sensor readings at the update interval (default 30 seconds). This also controls dashboard, automation, and history updates; availability changes are immediate. If the meter's Export energy grows while you buy electricity (for example, export is larger than your total solar production), enable Meter mounted in reverse: the Import and Export energy entities swap labels and helper sources, while each keeps its history. It does not change power sensors; set their direction with the power sign above.

data.meter_reversed: Meter mounted in reverse (swap import/export energy)

logger.title: Inverter logger
logger.description: Enter the IP address or hostname of the Solis S2-WL-ST logger to add local inverter readings. The logger is only read (Modbus function 04); nothing is written to the inverter or logger, and SolisCloud reporting is not changed. Leave the address empty to disable polling.

utility_meters.title: Create utility meters
utility_meters.description: Create standard Utility Meter helpers for the selected cycles and sources. Existing matching helpers are kept, and nothing is recreated on restart. The first period starts when a helper is created. Estimated solar/household energy sources need a configured logger.

logger_unreachable.title: Solis inverter logger unreachable
logger_unreachable.description: Home Assistant has failed to read the Solis S2-WL-ST logger five times in a row, so inverter sensors are unavailable. Check that the logger is powered, connected to your network and still has the configured IP address. Download the integration diagnostics for the last error type. This issue clears after the next successful read.

unsupported_model.title: Unsupported Solis inverter model
unsupported_model.description: The logger answered, but the inverter's model code is not 0x3306 (S6-EH3P 5–10K-H), so inverter sensors stay unavailable. Download the integration diagnostics to see the reported model code.
